text: DSH Web Search Firecrawl（DSH 网页客户端插件）：为 DSH 网页搜索接入 Firecrawl。它在 web seam 注册搜索提供方，将查询发送至 /v1/search，并把链接、标题和限长描述映射为网页来源。插件详情页可编辑 API key、结果数和摘要长度，也可即时切回 DeepSeek 搜索。适合需要 Firecrawl 搜索及 DeepSeek 回退选项的 DSH 用户；需配置 Firecrawl API key。

DSH Web Search Firecrawl connects Firecrawl to DSH web search. It sends queries to /v1/search and maps links, titles, and bounded descriptions to web sources. Its plugin details page edits the API key and search limits, or switches live to DeepSeek. Requires a Firecrawl API key.

DSH Web Search Firecrawl 的功能「Firecrawl 网页搜索」：把 web 搜索查询发送到 Firecrawl /v1/search，并将返回的 URL、标题和描述整理为网页来源；描述会按配置截短。
DSH Web Search Firecrawl 的功能「DeepSeek 搜索回退」：在配置中关闭 Use Firecrawl 后，搜索请求交给原 DeepSeek 搜索提供方，无需卸载插件。
DSH Web Search Firecrawl 的功能「插件详情设置」：在浏览器的插件详情页查看和编辑搜索开关、API key、结果数和摘要长度，配置更改应用到后续搜索。
使用 DSH Web Search Firecrawl 前需要 Firecrawl API key；未配置时 Firecrawl 提供方不可用。可在插件设置中填写，或通过 FIRECRAWL_API_KEY 提供。

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · dsh-web-search-firecrawl：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [Firecrawl](https://firecrawl.dev)-backed search provider for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`): it makes the built-in `web_search` tool run on Firecrawl's search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek route.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · dsh-web-search-firecrawl：The plugin is a Cordis function plugin that registers a `WebSearchProvider` (`id: firecrawl`) into the seam — it does not own `ctx.web` and does not register a model-facing tool (the tool schema stays with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`). It calls Firecrawl's `POST /v1/search` endpoint and maps the flat `data[]` into the seam's normalized `WebSearchResult`.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · dsh-web-search-firecrawl：The API key is configured in **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details**, not a separate Settings navigation entry. The form follows Harness semantic colors in both light and dark themes; `$FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` remains available as a compatibility fallback.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness official packages on the `0.2.1-rc.5` line, Cordis `4.0.5`, Schemastery `3.18.5`, and Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. The old `0.1.x` configuration API is not supported; see the [upgrade guide](docs/upgrading-0.2.md). Do not mix Harness release lines in one profile; check with `npm ls @deepseek-ai/dsh-web`.
- A Firecrawl API key. Get one at [firecrawl.dev](https://firecrawl.dev).

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Install：Choose **one** of the following:

**Option 1 — global `dsh` CLI**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl@latest
```

**Option 2 — `deepseek-harness` source checkout** (there `dsh` is a pnpm workspace script, not a global binary; run it from the workspace root):

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add @elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl@latest
```

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Install：`dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and appends the bundle to the profile's layer stack automatically. The bundle patch inserts the `web-search-firecrawl` plugin row and switches the `web` seam row to `searchProvider: firecrawl` (replacing the base bundle's `deepseek-official`), while preserving `fetchProvider: http` for page retrieval.

After installing, **restart `dsh web`**, then hard-refresh the page (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R) so the browser half and its settings page load:

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Install：```sh
dsh web
```

Verify: **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details** should show the configuration form, and asking the agent for a web search should route through Firecrawl. Without a key, a search fails with `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Install：To keep DeepSeek search as the default and enable Firecrawl per instance instead, restate the `web` row in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` afterwards — the last write wins per row. The base bundle pins `searchProvider: deepseek-official`, so `$DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` selects the provider only when the `web` row sets no `searchProvider`: restate `web` with only its fetch selection (`- id: web` + `config: { fetchProvider: http }`) for env selection, or with `searchProvider: deepseek-official` to pin DeepSeek.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Update：Global `dsh` CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update --latest @elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl
```

`deepseek-harness` source checkout — run from the workspace root:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web update --latest @elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl
```

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Update：`dsh plugin update` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory; `--latest` upgrades to the latest published version regardless of the currently installed range. After updating, **restart `dsh web`**, then hard-refresh the page (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R). If the plugin is installed in another profile, replace `web` with that profile name.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Uninstall：Global `dsh` CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl
```

`deepseek-harness` source checkout — run from the workspace root:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web remove @elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl
```

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Uninstall：`dsh plugin remove` forwards to pnpm inside the profile directory and also removes the package from `dsh.profile.bundles`. Once the bundle layer is gone, the `web` seam row reverts to the base bundle's `deepseek-official` provider. Restart `dsh web` for the removal to take effect in the running process.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Uninstall：The command removes the package and its mount, but not settings-page values. If you also want to delete the saved API key, clear it on the **Firecrawl** page before uninstalling. If the plugin was installed into another profile, replace `web` with that profile name.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Switching search providers：Installing the plugin switches the `web` seam's `searchProvider` to `firecrawl`, so Firecrawl replaces the original web search by default. In **Plugins → Firecrawl plugin details**, the **Use Firecrawl** switch at the top selects between the two providers live:

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Switching search providers：- **On (default)**: Firecrawl `POST /v1/search` is used.
- **Off**: the registered `firecrawl` provider delegates to the original DeepSeek search implementation, so the model keeps using the shipped DeepSeek search route; DeepSeek's endpoint/model still resolve from the original `web-search-deepseek` settings section.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Switching search providers：The fallback retains the official implementation's account authentication, credential resolution, and `web/deepseek-search-llm-request` Session logging. The switch applies immediately without a restart. Firecrawl credentials and request settings are preserved while off.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Configuring the API key：1. Paste `fc-...` into the **API Key** field and save. The eye button beside the field toggles plain-text visibility for the current draft.
2. The key is written to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` with `role('secret')`: the saved literal never rides a response; the page only shows whether a key is configured.
3. **Saving with the field blank keeps the current key**; use **Clear** to remove the user override and restore the composition value. A key supplied by the composition or environment remains available.
4. Changes apply **immediately** — the Loader updates `Volatile` references and the registered provider uses the new values on the next search, no restart required.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Configuring the API key：If the settings-page key is blank, the provider still falls back to `$FIRECRAWL_API_KEY`:

```sh
export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-...
dsh --profile web
```

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Config：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `useFirecrawl` | `true` | Whether to use Firecrawl; `false` switches back to the original DeepSeek web search. |
| `apiKey` | (blank) → `$FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` | Firecrawl API key. Written as a secret by the settings page and never echoed back. Blank falls back to the env var; with neither present the provider is unavailable. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.firecrawl.dev` | Endpoint base; `/v1/search` is appended. An unparseable value makes the provider unavailable. |
| `limit` | (unset) | Default result count when a request carries no `maxResults`. Unset sends no default. Must be a positive integer. |
| `maxSnippetChars` | `600` | Upper bound on characters kept from one `description` when mapping `snippet`. Must be a positive integer. |

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Config：Every field is edited through Harness's standard authenticated settings Remote API; the plugin no longer mounts a separate `/firecrawl/api` HTTP endpoint. The `Config` schema is projected automatically, and every field uses `.volatile()` so saves do not remount the provider. Bundle config is inherited beneath the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` overrides:

```yaml

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · profile cordis.patch.yml (optional; usually not needed)：- id: web-search-firecrawl
  name: '@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl'
  config:
    limit: 10
```

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Mapping：Firecrawl returns a flat `data[]` and no generated answer, so `content` is omitted. Each entry maps to a `WebSearchSource`: `url` ← `url`, `title` ← `title`, `snippet` ← `description` trimmed and bounded to `maxSnippetChars` (an entry without a non-blank description keeps its citeable URL-only source). A request's `maxResults` wins over the configured `limit` default and is sent as Firecrawl's `limit` for a cost/latency optimization; the final bound is enforced by the seam. Provider failures (HTTP errors, network failure, unparseable or wrong-shape bodies, a `success: false` envelope) surface as `WebError` `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR`; an aborted request surfaces as `WEB_ABORTED`. HTTP redirects are rejected before the `Location` target is contacted.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Model Experience：Indirect, through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web`: the model sees the `maxResults`-bounded URLs, titles, and bounded descriptions, plus the consumer's error wrapper around `Firecrawl search aborted`, `Firecrawl search request failed: <error>`, and `Firecrawl returned an unprocessable response body: <error>`. Generated answers and provider-private fields stay out of context.

@elves-ai/dsh-web-search-firecrawl README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test                            # unit suite (no network)
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=... pnpm run test:e2e  # live-API smoke, self-skips without the key
